notes: Claude's changes to templates, notes and highlights now show in the app straight away, without a restart. A drawing in its own window has its own Set scale… button and shows its scale. A drawing's own window has tabs, and its drawing list highlights the drawing shown. Zoomed in on a PDF, the drawing is shown sharp as map-style squares drawn in the background and kept, so moving around doesn't wait for it (Tools > Settings > View turns it off).
